description: This file contains helper functions related to financial calculations, specifically handling date and year-based calculations such as days per year and checking for the last day of a month.

classes.name: Helpers
classes.description: A helper class providing static methods for financial date calculations such as determining days per year and checking if a date is the last day of its month.

methods.name: daysPerYear
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a specified year based on the 'basis' parameter, which determines the day count convention.

methods.name: isLastDayOfMonth
methods.description: Checks whether a given date is the last day of its month.
